items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: The interviewer mentions Frank Moyer in the context of the band lineup ('We had Frank Moyer first... Not Frank Moyer. Frank Moyer, Wiggins, and then Smitty'). The interviewee does not provide any personal anecdote, opinion, or confirmation of a direct personal or professional relationship with Frank

ctx.x: Oh I can't think of his name but he gave Pickett a job, John Brunson, and John called me and asked him about taking the job and he would play some nights. And that's when we had went to the happy land.
One thing I wanted to ask you, when George Garner left the band, and I believe you had Smitty playing there. We had Frank Moyer first.
That fellow that was working the paddock.
